lead.headline: Golden is a 16:45 call, and his fallback now has a hamstring
lead.deck: 1-6. The lineup is the projection lineup. Check Green Bay's inactives at 16:45 tonight.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Matthew Golden is questionable tonight with a shoulder and a foot: he sat out Tuesday's walkthrough, was limited Wednesday, and Matt LaFleur's answer on whether he plays was 'I sure hope so.' The fallback is George Pickens — but Pickens was limited Wednesday too, with a hamstring added to the shoulder. He still plays Sunday, so the plan holds: if Golden is inactive at 16:45, start Pickens; if Pickens is then ruled out before Sunday noon, Rashee Rice, limited Wednesday, takes the slot. Josh Jacobs has no designation and leads the Packers' backfield tonight. Everything else is set: 126.6 to Metcalf Gala's 121.2, 53%.
